claims.claim: The plugin test suite passes with 0 failures (Hermes Agent v0.23.0 checkout, venv Python 3.11.16, Linux; python-docx installed from a scratch target dir on PYTHONPATH)
The panel backend answers estado (installed corpus + pack hash) and verificar (4/6 on the demo brief) when called against the installed package
claims.command: cd $HERMES_HOME/plugins/dike && HERMES_HOME=<profile-home> python -c "import importlib.util,sys; s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('a','dashboard/plugin_api.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); sys.modules[s.name]=m; s.loader.exec_module(m); print(m.estado()); print(m.verificar({'texto': open('tests/fixtures/escrito_demo.md').read()})['meta'])"

claims.claim: Content search over the sealed corpus (POST /grafo/buscar, scripts/panel.py grafo buscar) is a development measurement within the sample: recall@10 0.952, recall@5 0.823, mrr@10 0.636 over the 31 frozen queries of normas_qrels_v1, which cover 4 of the 25 statutes. The qrels were frozen with this same StarterCorpusRetriever and its constants were fixed while looking at the source goldset, so the numbers are not an independent holdout estimate.
